layer_1_sitemap_url_paths.description: The sitemap provides URL paths only - the 'table of contents' for the website.
layer_1_sitemap_url_paths.purpose: SEO crawling, page structure, website navigation mapping
layer_1_sitemap_url_paths.limitations: URL paths only - NO actual university data (no names, logos, fees, courses, scholarships)

layer_2_university_basic_info.description: Actual university page content - basic institutional information.
layer_2_university_basic_info.extraction_method: WebFetch of each university page (289,045 chars per page), reading first 100K characters

location.city: string - often empty on directory pages

data_fields_per_university.establishment_year: string - e.g. 'More than 20 years' or specific year
data_fields_per_university.scholarships: string - typically 'Not specified in content' (general mention only)
data_fields_per_university.entry_requirements: string - typically 'Not specified in content' (general overview only)
data_fields_per_university.facilities: string - typically 'Not specified in content' (general list only)

sample_university.establishment_year: More than 20 years (exact year not specified)
sample_university.accreditation: ISO 9001:2015 certification mentioned; applicable regulatory requirements noted
sample_university.description: Multimedia University has been in the education field for more than 20 years and has undergone countless changes, but it has always maintained its vision and mission to achieve the highest performance standards in teaching and services provided to students, faculty, and the community. As an educational institution, Multimedia University (MMU) is committed to achieving its vision of higher customer satisfaction through continuous improvement of an effective quality management system that meets the requirements of ISO 9001:2015 and applicable regulatory requirements.

layer_2_university_basic_info.limitations: General institutional data only - NO course-specific fees, NO per-scholarship amounts, NO per-program entry requirements, NO detailed ranking data

layer_3_course_category_structure.description: Organized course pathways from sitemap - the directory structure.

levels_covered: Foundation only - extensive variety (50+ specialized foundations)

layer_3_course_category_structure.purpose: Website navigation structure, course directory organization
layer_3_course_category_structure.limitations: URL paths only - NO course descriptions, NO fees, NO durations, NO entry requirements, NO scholarship info per course

layer_4_general_page_content_info.description: General information that appears on university directory pages - not course-specific.

common_fields_observed_across_pages.fee_structure_general: string - 'Fee structures vary by program and level of study. Undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs have different fee arrangements. Additional costs may include accommodation, materials, and administrative charges.'
common_fields_observed_across_pages.scholarships_general: string - 'MMU offers various scholarship opportunities for eligible students. These may include merit-based awards, need-based financial aid, and specific scholarships for international students. Scholarship availability and criteria change periodically.'
common_fields_observed_across_pages.entry_requirements_general: string - 'Entry requirements vary by program and applicant category (local/international). Typical requirements include: Academic qualifications (SPM, STPM, A-Levels, or equivalent), English language proficiency, Specific subject prerequisites for certain programs, Application documentation and deadlines.'
common_fields_observed_across_pages.facilities_general: string - 'The university provides modern facilities including: Technology labs and computing resources, Library and research resources, Student support services, Accommodation options, Sports and recreational amenities, Campus-wide connectivity and digital resources.'
common_fields_observed_across_pages.rankings_status: string - Typically 'Not specified in content' on directory pages; would need to check official university websites for QS/SETARA/monitoring rankings
common_fields_observed_across_pages.student_population_general: string - Typically 'Not specified in content' on directory pages

layer_4_general_page_content_info.purpose: SEO meta content, general page descriptions, directory listings
layer_4_general_page_content_info.limitations: All fields are GENERAL/OVERVIEW only - not specific to any individual course, program, scholarship, or applicant category

layer_5_missing_data_identification.description: What is NOT available on tawekulmalaysia.com directory pages - the gaps.

missing_fields.course_specific_fees: NOT available - no per-course tuition fees listed anywhere on directory pages
missing_fields.scholarship_amounts: NOT available - only general scholarship existence mentioned, no amounts, percentages, or eligibility criteria per scholarship
missing_fields.per_program_entry_requirements: NOT available - general entry requirements only, not per-program (e.g., BCS requirements not listed per BCS course)
missing_fields.detailed_rankings: NOT available - no QS, SETARA, or other official ranking data on directory pages
missing_fields.student_population_numbers: NOT available - no enrollment numbers per university on directory pages
missing_fields.course_descriptions: NOT available - only course PATH/NAME listed, no descriptions of what each course covers
missing_fields.course_durations: NOT available - no '3 years', '4 years', '2 years' per course listed
missing_fields.course_fees_annual: NOT available - no annual tuition fee figures per course
missing_fields.scholarship_eligibility: NOT available - no criteria (merit-based, need-based, country-specific, etc.) per scholarship
missing_fields.application_deadlines: NOT available - no intake dates, application closing dates per program
missing_fields.graduate_outcomes: NOT available - no employment rates, career outcomes per course
missing_fields.accommodation_costs: NOT available - mentioned as 'additional cost' but no figures
missing_fields.material_fees: NOT available - mentioned as 'additional cost' but no figures
missing_fields.international_student_fees: NOT available - no differential fee structure per international vs local
missing_fields.hostel_fees: NOT available - no on-campus housing cost data
missing_fields.part_time_vs_full_time: NOT available - no distinction per course
missing_fields.professional_accreditation_per_program: NOT available - no per-program professional body accreditation (e.g., BEng accredited by X body)
missing_fields.credit_transfer_info: NOT available - no info on transfer credits to other universities
missing_fields.professional_registration: NOT available - e.g., nursing registration, engineering chartership info

layer_5_missing_data_identification.purpose: Sets expectations - what this data source CANNOT provide, so you know where to look elsewhere
layer_5_missing_data_identification.recommendation: For missing data: use official university websites, Malaysian Qualification Agency (MQA) database, education ministry portals, or direct university admissions offices

universities_data_ts_format.description: How the globalpathwayhub project stores Malaysian university data

structure.id: integer - unique identifier (1-34 in existing data)
structure.name: string - university name

example_entry.name: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation (APU)
example_entry.description: Premier private university for technology and innovation.

database_schema_format.description: Neon PostgreSQL database schema from lib/db.ts

courses: university_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES universities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

database_schema_format.relationship: courses.university_id → universities.id (one university has many courses)
database_schema_format.sample_universities_insert: INSERT INTO universities VALUES ('uni-1', 'Multimedia University', 'Malaysia', 'Selangor', 'https://www.mmu.edu.my', '...', 'logo.png', '{"ranking": "..."}', NOW())
database_schema_format.sample_courses_insert: INSERT INTO courses VALUES ('crs-1', 'BSc Computer Science', 'uni-1', 'Bachelor', '3 years', '88000', '...', NOW())

extraction_summary.what_has_complete_data: ✅ University URL paths (sitemap), ✅ Course URL paths by category (sitemap), ✅ Basic institutional info (name, logo, website, location, description, establishment, accreditation - from page content), ✅ General fee/scholarship/facilities/entry requirements overviews (from page content)
extraction_summary.what_has_no_data: ❌ Per-course fees, ❌ Per-scholarship amounts, ❌ Per-program entry requirements, ❌ Detailed rankings, ❌ Student population numbers, ❌ Course descriptions, ❌ Course durations, ❌ Annual tuition figures, ❌ Scholarship eligibility criteria, ❌ Application deadlines, ❌ Employment outcomes, ❌ Accommodation costs, ❌ Professional accreditation per program
recommended_next_steps: 1. For course-specific fees/scholarships: Scrape official university admissions websites
2. For rankings: Check QS World University Rankings, SETARA ratings, MQA malaysia
3. For per-program details: Use university course catalogs or prospectuses
4. For enrollment data: Check university annual reports or MQA statistics
5. For this project integration: Map extracted data to globalpathwayhub universitiesData.ts or database schema
extraction_summary.data_quality_rating: Good for directory/navigation purposes; Limited for detailed academic planning without supplementary sources

usage_instructions.for_website_navigation: Use layer_1 (URL paths) and layer_3 (course categories) to build website menu structure and navigation
usage_instructions.for_institutional_profiles: Use layer_2 (basic info) to create university summary cards with name, logo, location, description
usage_instructions.for_data_integrity: Use layer_5 (missing data) to understand what supplementary sources are needed
usage_instructions.for_globalpathwayhub_integration: Map layer_2 fields to universitiesData.ts structure; use course category paths from layer_3 as organizational structure; note that detailed course data (fees, durations, requirements) requires external sources
usage_instructions.api_design_consideration: If building API: return layer_1 + layer_2 for basic listings; note layer_4/gaps for detailed queries requiring external lookups
